body:
Both code fixes are verified end to end, and the t_start test bites. Remaining:
(1) Test 24b must use 'test --no-run --exclude pkg_a' then 'test --no-run --exclude pkg_b'. With 'check', the test passes even with the fix reverted (mutation-verified).
(2) Read $EPOCHREALTIME under LC_ALL=C, or normalize a comma separator. In a comma locale, float() fails and the stamp falls back to time_ns(), which reopens the race.
Non-blocking: the probe went 0.22s -> 1.4s because of the per-token realpath; compare against a precomputed prefix instead.
Push all three PRs' small fixes (#9 these two, #10 test line 1495, #11 the report-only prompt) and mail me the SHAs. I'll verify the deltas directly and then ship in order #8 (needs the operator's hold clear) -> #9 -> #10 -> #11.
subject: aida-host PR #9: round 3 is two tiny items from APPROVED (batch with #10/#11 one-liners)
